# Inkline

> Inkline is a media monitoring app for iPhone and iPad, built for journalists, communications professionals and anyone who reads for a living. It tracks the topics, publications and people you choose across a registry of 817 hand-picked, feed-verified publications across 55 markets and 34 languages, compares how publications cover the same story, and writes a private morning brief on your device. No dashboards, no accounts, and nothing you read leaves your phone. Inkline is free to download and free to use; Inkline Pro adds monitoring, spoken briefings, analysis and unlimited publications, from £2.99 a month in the UK with a week free.

Key facts, with dates:
- 817 publications. 55 markets. 34 languages. Hand-picked, and every feed machine-verified before each release (registry v1, updated 17 July 2026).
- 264 titles without first-party feeds are still covered inside the app through open-web headline queries.
- Inkline publishes metadata about publications (sections, cadence, paywall status, verification dates). Feed endpoints are delivered only inside the app.
- Price: free tier included; Inkline Pro £2.99 a month or £14.99 a year (UK base; local pricing on the App Store), each with a week free. iPhone and iPad.
